product_one_liner.value: Gushwork uses AI agents to help small and midsize businesses get discovered across AI search, Google, and paid channels and convert that interest into qualified inbound leads.

employee_band.notes: A recent profile reported 202 employees; LinkedIn also displays a 51–200 size range, so the band follows the more specific numerical count.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index consists of marketing and SEO guidance rather than engineering posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Gushwork’s public Relay developer documentation links to multiple SDK, API-reference, configuration, prompts and error-handling articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Lever board lists open roles, but none has an AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed product material, blog and privacy policy did not identify a provider powering Gushwork’s own product; blog references to third-party models describe the market generally.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy references GDPR as a legal framework but does not claim any of the listed certifications or compliance attestations.

raised_18mo.notes: The $9 million seed round was announced in February 2026, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists an Account Executive, Business Development Representative and multiple Sales Development Representative openings.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced AI Editor on June 2, 2026 and a B2B commerce product on July 21, 2026, both within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The checked executive-leadership page lists the two co-founders; the CTO profile dates his Gushwork start to April 2025, before the 12-month window. No qualifying change was found; the team listing is third-party and unverified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These tools are named in the company’s Revenue Operations job posting as core expertise or integration tools.
